name: india-verified
description: India Verified — monorepo root. The deployable Next.js app lives in frontend/, the Python pipeline in worker/.

scripts.dev: npm --prefix frontend exec -- next dev frontend -p 8080 -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.emit-dist:
node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.html', 'India Verified

Next.js build output is in frontend/.next — deployed by Vercel from the frontend directory.')"
